sources.observation: The allocator GC trigger body is disabled; collection is externally driven, not an automatic allocation-threshold policy.
FindNative linearly scans native_properties, creates an atom for each stored key and frees it for every lookup.
HostGet constructs a scoped handle and CallbackState before native-property and ordinary property/prototype lookup. Any optimization must retain interception, security and receiver semantics.
Handle-cell/API-view block ownership is stored on Isolate; released entries are recycled through free lists. This does not quantify their contribution to OS private bytes.
The corrected joint visitor preserves one worklist cursor across drains in an epoch and resolves ephemerons after newly queued work, instead of replaying the entire prefix per wrapper.

measurement_scope: Existing forced-GC and debugger diagnostic records are explicitly separate from unprofiled comparison matrices. No numerical speedup is inferred solely from source inspection.
memory_caveat: JS used bytes, native allocated bytes, process private commit and process working set are distinct. A decrease in live objects does not imply equal private-commit reclamation.
retention_caveat: Final same-library diagnostics repeat React6240wrappers/6239edges through epoch17 after View release, explicit GC and main idle drain; Vue reaches0/0. Scheduler/MessagePort/realm candidates are not a proven root or a proven leak.
